name: Tank pals
summary: An ambient shared fish tank for a group chat with one fish per friend in their colour; fish nobody has fed for a day sink low and slow, anyone can tap a fish to drop flakes and watch it dart up to eat, and each friend can put one thing on the gravel.
useWhen: we should get a group pet for the chat
make a little fish tank for 412 pine that we all take care of
something cute that just lives in the chat
a tamagotchi thing for the six
remind people to check in on each other but make it fish
dontUseWhen: real chores or a rota (use chore-wheel or chore-draft)
a game with a winner (use rock-skip or trivia-night)
a real pet's feeding schedule (use signup-board)

fish.description: One fish per friend in the chat: its name, hours since someone last fed it (0 to 72), and who did

decor.description: Things already on the gravel, one per friend
